title: Lior and the Postcards
author: Vesper Nakamura
blurb: Yara Hartwell, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
